title: Director of Manufacturing
text:
We are seeking a strategic, technical, and results-driven Director of Manufacturing to lead and optimize high-volume packaging blow molding facility. As a key member of the executive leadership team, you will bridge organizational strategy with daily shop floor execution by overseeing multi-shift operations, managing the operational budget, and driving performance across safety, quality, delivery, cost, and talent development. To succeed in this role, you will bring deep technical expertise in plastic blow molding technologies, automated downstream packaging, and strong financial acumen to achieve large-scale operational excellence.
 
 
In terms of strategic leadership and daily operations, you will execute manufacturing strategies that maximize throughput, cycle times, and capacity utilization across all production lines. You will oversee multi-shift operations to foster a culture of accountability and high performance on the plant floor while maintaining disciplined daily management routines, including production reviews, KPI tracking, and systematic escalation procedures. Additionally, you will translate forecasting and demand data into actionable manufacturing plans, master schedules, and staffing models designed to meet fast-paced consumer goods delivery timelines.
 
 
From a technical and equipment management perspective, you will optimize processing parameters across a diverse fleet of plastic blow molding machinery and drive high-speed automation projects. You will also oversee material management to maximize the efficiency of high-volume grades. Partner closely with Maintenance and Tooling teams to minimize changeover downtime, and enforce rigorous preventive maintenance programs.
